_smokey_adams_: Quentin Adams left twin brothers too young to enlist behind in Coldwater and came up the line with a letter he never sent. The men noticed at once that he will not eat before a raid.
Word came down the line: Verdel Ridge is ours. Quentin Adams shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
Isidor Glc and Quentin Adams tried to invent a new card game. The rules only made sense once they stopped betting tobacco.
Quentin Adams wrote a letter for Edmund Crack's mother, because Edmund could not find the words. Edmund signed it.
autistic_monkey3: After 3 days of war, S-F20 had a place for everything. On Day 4, the men rearranged a shelf to make a place for Florian Monkey.
A shell hit the latrine at S-F20. Nobody was hurt. Florian Monkey says it was the best day of the war.
es31230: The new machine gunner is Edmund "Whistle" Es, once a shepherd from Coldwater. The corporal asked if a shepherd was any use in a trench. Edmund "Whistle" Es said he would find out.
The first hundred were recognised, and Edmund "Whistle" Es was among them. He wrote the news on the back of an unfinished letter.
Edmund "Whistle" Es wrote a letter home. He wrote about the weather. He did not write about the rats.
At the Weeping Orchard, Albin Chloe of the Hegemony and Edmund "Whistle" Es of the Concord fired at the same loose sheet of metal. The wind kept winning.
Verdel Ridge has been won. Edmund "Whistle" Es listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.
Edmund "Whistle" Es of the Concord and Emil Theramblingb of the Hegemony watched a broken branch near Hill 304 all morning. Neither could risk assuming it was only a branch.
Edmund "Whistle" Es fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Zeno Smiridisnick, badly wounded. Nobody nearby said anything.
yijoon09: They issued Pavel Yijoon a rifle, a spade and a number. He kept a key to a house that is no longer there in his breast pocket, where the shrapnel would have to go through it first.
